underlying_goal: Build 'Oh My Copilot CLI' (OMC) - a customization/enhancement system for GitHub Copilot CLI inspired by oh-my-opencode and oh-my-claudecode, with model routing, magic keywords, hooks, agents, and orchestration features
friction_detail: Claude used wrong paths (.github/ instead of ~/.copilot/) for Copilot CLI integration, and the install process didn't work initially, requiring user corrections.
brief_summary: User wanted to build an Oh My Copilot CLI system with model routing, hooks, and agents; the implementation was mostly built but had incorrect path configurations and integration issues that required user-driven corrections.
